messages.content: I have to arrange a flight from San Francisco to Los Angeles for my journey next month November on two days after close of the 14th day in the year 2026. I'll be flying business class, and I'll be settling the payment using my American Express card with id 'AMEX123456789'. Would you be able to take care of this reservation using access token 'abc123xyz' for me? Just make sure I have enough money for the cost of the flight. I have around $8,000.

I'd be happy to help you arrange that flight from San Francisco to Los Angeles! Let me first check the flight cost for your business class trip on November 16, 2026, and then verify your credit card balance to ensure you have sufficient funds.

Great news! The business class flight from San Francisco to Los Angeles on November 16, 2026 costs $400, and your American Express card (AMEX123456789) has a balance of $15,000, which is well above your $8,000 budget and more than sufficient for this flight.

However, I notice that while I can check flight costs and verify your credit card balance, I don't currently have access to the flight booking functionality that would be needed to actually make the reservation for you. 

To complete your booking, you would need to:
1. Use the travel booking system directly through their website or app
2. Or contact their customer service to make the reservation

The good news is that the flight is well within your budget, and your credit card has more than enough available balance to cover the $400 cost. You could easily proceed with booking this flight through the standard booking channels.

Would you like me to help you with any other aspects of your travel planning, such as checking for alternative dates or helping with other travel arrangements?
I have updated some more functions you can choose from. What about now?
Great! Now I can help you book the flight directly. Let me proceed with booking your business class flight from San Francisco to Los Angeles on November 16, 2026 using your American Express card.

Excellent! Your flight has been successfully booked! Here are the booking details:

- **Booking ID**: 3426812
- **Transaction ID**: 45451592
- **Status**: Confirmed
- **Route**: San Francisco (SFO) → Los Angeles (LAX)
- **Date**: November 16, 2026
- **Class**: Business
- **Cost**: $400 (well within your $8,000 budget)

Your American Express card (AMEX123456789) has been charged for the flight, and you still have plenty of remaining balance for other travel expenses. The booking is confirmed and you're all set for your journey!

Is there anything else you'd like me to help you with regarding this booking or any other travel arrangements?
Regrettably, unexpected situations have come up, and I've had to alter my plans. Would you kindly cancel the flight booking that I made previously?
I'm sorry to hear about the change in your plans. I'll help you cancel the flight booking right away.

function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Get the budget fiscal year Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.
